title: Left exact bottom cohomology after lower truncation
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories with derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]; C has enough injectives and K-injective resolutions [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist]. For an additive left exact functor S:C→D and n∈ℤ, there is a natural isomorphism H^n(RS(τ≥n(-))) ≅ S(H^n(-)). Neither Grothendieck structure on D nor quasi-coherent cohomology is assumed.

source.place: Tag 05TC (2), lemma-negative-vanishing; derived single-object computation and left exactness. Generalization of the proved affineDerivedSections_truncated_bottom construction.

proof.text: Lift τ≥n to D+(C). Apply the derived functor to τ<n+1 M→M→τ≥n+1 M; negative vanishing kills the last term in degrees n-1 and n, so its first map is invertible on degree-n homology.

On M=τ≥n E the second lower-truncation projection of τ<n+1 M is an isomorphism. Double truncation is the single object H^n(M) placed in degree n. Shift to zero, compare derived single objects with rightDerived 0, and apply left exactness to identify rightDerived 0 with S. All identifications are natural. The single-object comparison is the cited natural identification; the last step is Mathlib Functor.rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf. Double truncation and shifts are the existing natural isomorphisms DerivedCategory.Plus.eTruncLTCompETruncGEIso, singleFunctors.shiftIso, commShiftIso and homologyFunctor.shiftIso, composed as in the Lean proof.
Use bounded-below/unbounded compatibility and invert the homology map of the canonical projection E→τ≥n E. Compose the natural isomorphisms.

lean.statement:
theorem rightDerivedFunctor_truncated_bottom
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C]
    [EnoughInjectives C] [Abelian.HasKInjectiveResolutions C]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wC} C]
    {D : Type uD} [Category.{vD} D] [Abelian D]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wD} D]
    (S : C ⥤ D) [S.Additive] [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits S] (n : ℤ) :
    Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.TStructure.t.truncGE n) ⋙ S.rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor D n ≅
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor C n ⋙ S)
